description: This file provides functions for analyzing OTA partition updates, including statistical analysis of operations such as block operations, payload size, merge operations, and file extension usage. It also includes functions to visualize data and distribute extension-based data sizes.

methods.name: addNumberToMap(map, key, value)
methods.description: Adds a numerical value to a specified key in a map, initializing to zero if the key does not exist.

methods.name: operatedBlockStatistics(partitions)
methods.description: Returns statistics over the number of blocks operated on, categorized by operation type, for given partitions.

methods.name: mergeOperationStatistics(partitions, blockSize)
methods.description: Returns statistics over merge operations categorized by type, summing across partitions, considering block sizes.

methods.name: operatedPayloadStatistics(partitions)
methods.description: Returns statistics over the disk usage of payload.bin, categorized by operation type, for the given partitions.

methods.name: operatedExtensionStatistics(partitions, blockSize, targetFile)
methods.description: Returns statistics of file extension usage in OTA packages, distributed by data length, for specified partitions.

methods.name: analysePartitions(metrics, partitions, blockSize = 4096, targetFile = null)
methods.description: Performs analysis on partitions based on specified metrics and returns visual data for plotting.

methods.name: numBlocks(exts)
methods.description: Calculates total number of blocks involved in a list of installation operations.

methods.name: displayBlocks(exts)
methods.description: Creates a string representation of block ranges for a list of installation operations.

methods.name: distributeExtensions(filenames, exts, length)
methods.description: Distributes total data length among file extensions proportionally based on extent block counts.

methods.name: name2Extension(filename)
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension from a filename.

ctags.name: analysePartitions
ctags.pattern: /^export async function analysePartitions(metrics, partitions, blockSize = 4096, targetFile = null/
